body: Home: a thatched cottage at 14 Wobblestone Lane, Puddingshire, with a reading nook under the eaves and one chimney.
A purple Glidemaster 9 hovercart, bought used in 2024. Its odometer reads in leagues.
The hovercart mechanic on Sprocket Row, run by Gizmo Tinkerfoot.

description: Hovercart passed its annual float inspection at Gizmo's Garage, 41,200 leagues
body:
## Inspection
The Glidemaster passed its annual float inspection at Gizmo's Garage.

- Odometer: 41,200 leagues
- Hover height: 14 inches, in spec
- Cost: $95

Gizmo said the anti-gravity coil hums a little and should be watched.
The potions Dr. Jekyll has the user take, and their doses.
Henry Jekyll, the user's potion physician at the Lantern Street Apothecary.
A tonic pressed from moonberries, taken in drops at night.
A bitter draught of thistle, taken by the spoonful in the morning.

description: Dr. Jekyll started moonberry tonic, 2 drops nightly, and thistle draught for my glowing left ear
body:
## Visit
Saw Dr. Jekyll at the Lantern Street Apothecary about my left ear, which has glowed faintly green since May.

## Potions
- Moonberry tonic: 2 drops nightly
- Thistle draught: 1 spoon each morning

## Next
Follow-up in about five weeks.

description: Dr. Jekyll's potion instructions: moonberry tonic 2 drops nightly, thistle draught 1 spoon mornings
body:
LANTERN STREET APOTHECARY
Patient instructions, 5 June 2026

Moonberry tonic: 2 drops under the tongue each night.
Thistle draught: 1 spoon each morning, with toast.
Do not take either within an hour of singing.
Return in five weeks.

description: Planted two rows of turnips in the cottage garden
body: Planted two rows of Puddingshire purple turnips along the south wall of the cottage garden.
